coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Datadog

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your R&D Finance team has to turn engineering and product spend into budgets and forecasts that technical leaders can act on. I faced a similar problem when the forecast for the larger of my two business units kept missing. I rebuilt the model around order backlog, and accuracy rose from 88% to 96%.

As a Financial Analyst at Calder Industrial Components, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units with combined revenue of about 85 million USD. With 5 years of experience in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, I'm used to sitting down with operational leaders to explain what the numbers mean. I also cut our month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, so consistent templates and processes are something I build as well as use. My Excel is advanced (INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, VBA), I build Power BI dashboards on SAP data, and I hold a B.S. in Finance. I haven't worked in Pigment, but I've learned reporting tools quickly, and I'd expect to pick up your planning and BI stack the same way.

The chance to support annual budgeting and financial targets, and to work alongside Datadog's product and engineering leadership, is the kind of cross-functional role I want next. I can start a conversation any time that suits your team, and I'd welcome walking you through my forecast model.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt

Dear Datadog Hiring Team,

Your FP&A role centers on forecasting and budgeting with senior leaders, and I've spent 5 years in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, including rebuilding a forecast model around order backlog.

I bring advanced Excel, financial modeling and Power BI dashboards, so I can turn complex data into clear variance analysis for budget owners.

My CV and cover letter are attached for your review.

I'm available for a call any weekday this week and can start a conversation at your convenience.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
